sources.guides: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/ (tts, stt, image-generation, video-generation); live API facts supplied 2026-10-17
sources.elevenlabs: [verified] https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/elevenlabs-on-openrouter ; https://openrouter.ai/docs/features/multimodal/tts ; supplied facts fetched 2026-10-17. Evidence and one maintainer A/B: ../elevenlabs-tagging.md.

_meta.routes_note: openrouter = curl against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY from shell environment only. No ElevenLabs music/SFX/voice-library access; those stay on the direct ElevenLabs route.
_meta.discovery_note: Live discovery is the source of truth; no hard-coded model assumptions. GET /api/v1/models is public with no key needed for listing; filter output_modalities=speech|transcription|image|video (one modality per query). Check supported_voices for TTS and /images/models and /videos/models for controls. This file is only a seed/fallback when offline or the list is unreachable; label fallback choices unconfirmed and recheck before generation.
_meta.unknown_policy: Unknown values are null, never zero. Entries verify listing/documentation, not successful paid generations or every optional control.
_meta.cost_note: Estimates only from live /models pricing.prompt and pricing.completion strings in USD; units depend on model (TTS usually input characters, sometimes output seconds; STT seconds or tokens). Video /videos/models pricing_skus units are CENTS: divide by 100 for USD, then multiply by applicable duration/count. No fixed credit price: use the user's spend.credits_per_usd; missing means no default.

elevenlabs/eleven-v4.best_for: [verified] Tag-directed speech through 21 named OpenRouter voices; project voices[].model selects it. Listing presence varies; confirm availability before generation.
elevenlabs/eleven-v4.best_for_source: [verified] OpenRouter ElevenLabs announcement and TTS docs, supplied 2026-10-17
limitations: [verified] Same bracket tag syntax in input as direct v3/v4; 90+ languages; 10,000 chars/request per announcement (model page states no limit); tags count toward limits and billing per Unicode code point. [maintainer-observed] Delivery is model-specific; model-change listening review: ../elevenlabs-tagging.md.
[verified] voice is one of 21 named voices (for example george, sarah, adam). [unverified] Direct-account voice portability; never silently swap a kept voice.
[verified] Omit instructions (ignored for ElevenLabs) and speed (v4/v4 Turbo reject non-default speed); use tags/punctuation for all direction.

[observed] instructions: accepted without error but had no observable effect on elevenlabs/eleven-v4 in one A/B (2026-10-17); do not rely on it; output is nondeterministic so one test is indicative, not proof
[verified] response_format mp3|pcm, default pcm. ElevenLabs settings go under provider.options.elevenlabs; see ../elevenlabs-tagging.md for keys/codec matching and continuity context.

elevenlabs_tts._source: [verified] Model-family limits and controls: OpenRouter ElevenLabs announcement, supplied 2026-10-17; ../elevenlabs-tagging.md. [unverified] Exact route ids, availability, supported voices and prices beyond the documented elevenlabs/eleven-v4; discover them, never derive slugs from these upstream ids.
elevenlabs_tts.notes: [verified] Put tags in input only where tags_supported is true; tags count toward Unicode-code-point billing and request limits. All ElevenLabs settings go under provider.options.elevenlabs. Context previous_text/next_text ~500 chars each way; see ../elevenlabs-tagging.md for complete keys, codec matching and evidence. Failed generations are not billed. [inferred] Strip/convert unsupported tags to avoid literal readings.
elevenlabs_tts.speed_note: [verified] Omit speed for v4/v4 Turbo; non-default values rejected. Multilingual v2/Flash: 0.7-1.2 at provider.options.elevenlabs.voice_settings.speed. [unverified] null means speed support not established (v3/Turbo v2 family); omit unless verified.
